whatsapp_setup_note: Enter the credentials from your Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API app. Messages are sent from your own WhatsApp Business number.
leave_blank_to_keep_existing: Leave blank to keep the existing token
whatsapp_webhook_note: Add this callback URL and verify token in your Meta App webhook configuration to receive delivery statuses.
saved_but_connection_failed: Settings saved, but the connection test failed:
whatsapp_test_message_body: This is a test message from your school management system. Your WhatsApp integration is working!
your_package_does_not_allow_this_action: Your current package does not allow this action.
whatsapp_is_not_enabled: WhatsApp is not enabled. Save your credentials and enable it first.
whatsapp_template_variables_missing: The template must keep these required variables:
whatsapp_feature_settings_note: These limits and permissions apply to every school whose package includes the WhatsApp Messaging feature.
whatsapp_integration_note: Manage your WhatsApp Business Cloud API, templates, and track message delivery across your institution from one place.
enable_whatsapp_note: Turn off to temporarily suspend all outbound messages.
access_token_warning: Do not share this token. It provides full access to your WhatsApp API.
whatsapp_test_note: A pre-approved "hello_world" template will be sent. Enter the number with country code (e.g. 91XXXXXXXXXX).
no_messages_yet_note: Messages sent through the WhatsApp API will appear here. It looks like you haven't sent any messages yet.
meta_template_name_hint: Optional. Name of an approved template in your Meta WhatsApp Business account. When set, that template is sent instead of the text above — guaranteed delivery even outside the 24-hour window.
meta_template_name_format: The Meta template name may only contain lowercase letters, numbers and underscores.
meta_body_param: Send message text as template parameter
meta_body_param_hint: Requires an approved Meta template that contains a {{1}} body variable (with text around it). Your edited message text is delivered through it.
meta_delivery_fixed_hint: The approved content of the linked Meta template will be delivered — the message text below is used for preview and logs only. Enable the parameter option to deliver your own text.
meta_delivery_param_hint: Your message text will be delivered through the Meta template's {{1}} parameter — guaranteed delivery. Line breaks are converted to spaces.
meta_delivery_text_hint: Free text is only delivered within 24 hours after the recipient last messaged your WhatsApp number.
default_meta_relay_template_hint: Create ONE approved template in Meta with a {{1}} body variable. Every panel template without its own Meta link is delivered through it automatically — no need to add each template to Meta.
default_meta_document_template: Default Meta Document Template (For PDF / File Attachments)
default_meta_document_template_hint: Approved Meta template created with header type DOCUMENT and a {{1}} body variable. Used automatically whenever the message carries a PDF, DOC, XLS, CSV or TXT file — for example the fee receipt.
default_meta_image_template: Default Meta Image Template (For Image Attachments)
default_meta_image_template_hint: Approved Meta template created with header type IMAGE and a {{1}} body variable. Used automatically whenever the message carries a JPG or PNG image.
meta_media_template_fallback_hint: A Meta template header type is fixed when the template is created and cannot be changed per message, so text, document and image each need their own template. Leaving a media template empty is safe: those messages are still delivered through the text template with the file download link added to the message.
whatsapp_image_too_large: The image is larger than 5 MB. WhatsApp does not accept images above 5 MB — compress it or send it as a PDF.
whatsapp_hint_parameter_mismatch: The template parameters do not match the approved template in Meta. Check that the template used for this message has the expected header type (none / document / image) and a {{1}} body variable.
whatsapp_hint_media_not_fetched: Meta could not download the attached file. Make sure your site is reachable from the internet and the file type and size are supported (images max 5 MB, documents max 100 MB).
meta_language_code_format: Enter the Meta template language code (e.g. en, en_US or hi), not the language name. It must match the language of the approved template in Meta.
whatsapp_hint_recipient_not_allowed: Your Meta app is in development mode: add this number in Meta under WhatsApp > API Setup > To > Manage phone number list, or switch the app to Live mode.
whatsapp_hint_template_not_found: This template name + language combination does not exist (or is not approved) in your WhatsApp Business account. Check the exact template name and language code (en vs en_US) in Meta > Message Templates.
meta_delivery_relay_hint: Your message text will be delivered through the default relay template
template_test_note: The message is rendered with sample values (sample student, amount, dates) and sent through the same delivery pipeline the automatic events use.
bulk_send_note: Pick a template, fill in the values, select the recipients and send — one message per recipient is queued.
select_recipients_note: Filter by role, then tick the users who should receive the message. Users without a mobile number are skipped.
please_select_users: Please select at least one recipient
no_recipients_with_mobile: None of the selected recipients have a mobile number.
bulk_messages_queued: :queued messages queued for sending. :skipped skipped (no mobile number).
manual_template_variables_note: Type {{variable_name}} anywhere in the message to create a fill-in value. {{recipient_name}} and {{school_name}} are filled automatically.
no_manual_templates_note: No manual templates yet — create one in the Manual Templates tab first.
repeat_weekly_hint: The first send happens at the selected date & time, then repeats every week on the same weekday and time.
repeat_monthly_hint: The first send happens at the selected date & time, then repeats every month on the same day and time.
please_select_schedule_datetime: Please select the schedule date & time
schedule_time_must_be_future: The scheduled time must be in the future.
cancel_schedule_warning: This scheduled message will not be sent anymore.
retry_selected_confirm: Retry the selected failed messages? Only rows with a failed status are retried.
no_failed_messages_selected: Please select the failed messages to retry.
csv_format_note: Column 1 = mobile with country code, column 2 = name (optional). A header row is detected automatically. Max 5000 contacts.
csv_no_valid_contacts: No valid mobile numbers found in the CSV. Numbers must be 8-15 digits including country code.
csv_parsed_summary: :valid valid contacts imported (:invalid invalid, :duplicates duplicates skipped).
please_upload_csv: Please upload a CSV with contacts first
external_users_send_note: Select external contacts from your directory. Manage them in the External Users tab.
invalid_mobile_number: Invalid mobile number. Use 8-15 digits including the country code.
mobile_already_exists: This mobile number already exists in your contacts.
contacts_synced_summary: :added contacts added, :updated updated (:invalid invalid rows skipped).
cost_per_message_hint: Used to show schools the expected monthly cost (Used × Cost).
cost_not_configured: Cost not configured by the administrator.
media_relay_template_hint: Optional. Approved Meta template with a DOCUMENT header and a {{1}} body. When empty, attachments are delivered as a tappable link inside your main relay template — one template handles everything.
attachment_hint: PDF, document or image (images max 5MB, other files max 10MB) — sent to every recipient along with the message. Great for circulars, timetables and homework. Without a media template configured in Settings the file is delivered as a download link.
meta_messaging_tier_hint: Unique recipients per 24h, set by Meta. Grows automatically with good quality.
tracked_by_panel: Accepted messages counted by this panel
billed_by_meta: billed by Meta to your account
meta_cost_unavailable_hint: Needs the whatsapp_business_management permission on your access token.

unable_to_determine_your_location: Unable to determine your current location. Please enable location services and try again.
attendance_for_today_is_closed: Today's attendance is closed. Please contact the school administration for any correction.

attendance_processing_failed: Unable to process attendance at this time. Please try again or contact the school administrator.
missing_punch_out_report_subject: Staff Attendance - Missing Punch Out Report - :date
missing_punch_out_report_intro: :count staff member(s) punched in but never punched out on this date. The system does not create a punch out automatically, so each case needs a manual correction.
missing_punch_out_report_note: Open Staff Attendance in the admin panel to review and correct these records. The original QR punch history is preserved.
school_timezone_help: Used for attendance dates, QR expiry and the attendance finalization job.
all_items_must_pass_before_enabling: All items must pass before QR attendance can be switched on.
scanning_stops_at_school_end: Scanning stops at school end time.
attendance_location_help: The scanner only opens when the staff member's device is inside this circle.
punch_retention_note: Punch in / punch out records are deleted automatically after 1 month. A monthly job clears them. Finalized attendance is never deleted, so every attendance report remains complete.
shift_based_help: Only the part of each session that falls inside the assigned shift window counts.
day_based_help: Every completed session counts in full, even outside the shift window.
day_based_note: Note: Shift assignment is compulsory to get full/half day required minutes from the shifts table. Working hours for day based calculation are from school start and end time, instead of the shift time range.
thresholds_help: Multiple punch in / punch out sessions are added together before the thresholds are applied.
shift_starts_on_joining_date: The shift applies from the joining date.
shift_change_not_retroactive: Days already finalized keep their original shift.
live_floor_help: One row per staff member. The striped band is the assigned shift; solid bars are completed punch in to punch out sessions.
in_with_no_out: Punch in with no punch out yet
open_sessions_warning: If they are still open at finalization they will be excluded from working hours and reported by email.
staff_without_shift_warning: staff have no shift assigned and cannot punch by QR.
finalization_idempotent_note: Finalization writes one attendance row per staff member per day. Re-running it never creates duplicates.
month_matrix_asterisk_note: An asterisk marks a day with a punch in that never got a punch out.
only_missing_punch_out: Only show days with a missing punch out
shift_window_against_punches: Shift window against the actual punch sessions
raw_qr_events_note: Raw QR events, exactly as captured. Manual corrections never alter these rows.
correction_history_note: Every manual change to the final result, with its reason.
excluded_incomplete: Incomplete session, excluded from working hours
clipped_to_shift: Clipped to the shift window from :full min
threshold_explanation: :worked min against half day :half min and full day :full min.
shift_snapshot_note: Values frozen at finalization. Later shift edits do not change this day.
leave_as_is_to_keep_calculated: Leave as is to keep the calculated value.
correction_keeps_punches_note: Saving sets the source to Manual. The QR punch events stay in the punch history unchanged.
missing_punch_out_detail_note: The :time punch in has no matching punch out. It is stored but does not count toward working hours. The system never invents a punch out time.
shift_wise_note: Each staff-day counts once, under the shift assigned on that date.
